lead: Gulzar is best known as an Indian film director, born on 19 August 1933 in Dina.
As of 2026, he is 93 years old, and his birth date places him under the Leo sign.
He is associated with work such as Jai Ho and has been recognised with Dadasaheb Phalke Award and Academy Award for Best Original Song.
The sections that follow break down Gulzar's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
